blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: insertion sort — Insert key into ordered prefix.
shift — Move existing value to make room.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: The left portion is kept sorted. Read the next item as key and compare backwards with earlier elements.

blocks.title: Trace
blocks.text: Shift larger elements one position to the right, then insert key in the vacant position.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: Worst O(n²), already-sorted best O(n), auxiliary O(1); especially useful on small/nearly sorted arrays.
